name: Base-2 Digit Sum Invariance
description: Replaces base-10 powers with base-2 powers. In base 10, models trivially recognize that summing powers of 10 creates a number with distinct decimal places, implying a permutation. In base 2, summing exactly k powers of 2 to reach a sum with k set bits also strictly requires a permutation (as carries would reduce the popcount), but models are less likely to confidently map this to an exact-cover constraint without explicit bitwise framing.
